name: newsplatform
description: NewsPlatform - Independent news aggregator. Fetch latest published stories from diverse, independent channels.

tools.name: get_latest_stories
tools.description: Fetch the latest published news stories from NewsPlatform. Returns articles with headlines, excerpts, publication dates, and channel information. Stories are ordered by publication date (newest first).

limit.description: Maximum number of stories to return (1-100)

offset.description: Number of stories to skip for pagination

resources.name: About NewsPlatform
resources.description: Information about NewsPlatform - what it is, how it works, and what makes it unique

prompts.name: summarize_latest_news
prompts.description: Get a summary of the latest news stories from NewsPlatform

arguments.name: category
arguments.description: Optional: Filter by category (Politics, Technology, Business, etc.)
